notes.title: Official Launch Trailer for Motor Racing Battle! Arriving August 26!
notes.content: [p]Liquid Meow’s co-op racer [i]Motor Racing Battle[/i] races onto storefronts August 26 at 5:00 am (PT)! A 25 % launch-week discount knocks the price down to just US$4.49 for the first 14 days.[/p][p]Hop on your bike, blow past the competition, and—just like in the classic [i]Road Rash[/i] days—knock rivals off their seats with a well-timed weapon. Dynamic stage hazards, diverse maps, and a built-for-two multiplayer mode guarantee high-octane fun from the very first lap.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/51cdd197cf7913333e3ae4ac698207b680858ea4.png"][/img][/p][p]Follow the game or add it to your wishlist now, and you’ll get an instant alert the moment it launches or goes on sale.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399690"][/dynamiclink]Here’s how the full release improves on the demo:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]1. Two Ways to Play: Solo or Co-op[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/1c5eecae8171f11a49ff4fe9532336beebbda1a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/eedd8beb08df9aa971bce5415c21776d9bed56a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The full game offers both single-player and two-player modes. In solo mode you can use keyboard or gamepad; in co-op you can mix and match any of keyboard + gamepad, keyboard + keyboard, or gamepad + gamepad. Race through an endless series of stages alone, or team up with a friend—the pace is relaxed and there’s no forced win/lose pressure.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]2. Unlock a World of Tracks[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/8506c9b7ac9352d59adc09a02d1717e0c7857a2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/40e769341d76620daa25eac6e131ad4e2452dcd9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The full release unleashes multiple themed worlds and hundreds of handcrafted stages—blazing deserts, lush forests, neon-lit cities, frozen tundras, futuristic skylines, and plenty more places waiting to be discovered![/p][p][/p][h2][b]3. 50+ Rides & Weapons[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416248/7322232af2ff3b0c2cc6c2ec2d53eab701f309c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock and experiment with a wild garage of classic, tongue-in-cheek, and cutting-edge mounts and weapons—over fifty in total![/p][p][/p][h2][b]4. Full English Localization[/b][/h2][p]The entire game is now fully localized into English.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]5. Complete Steam Achievement Support[/b][/h2][p]Earn and collect every achievement to your heart’s content![/p]

notes.title: 《Motor Racing Battle》has now joined this year's STEAM NEXTFEST!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continuous support and attention to the game! We are excited to announce that Motor Racing Battle has confirmed its participation in the Steam NEXTFEST, which will take place from February 25th to March 4th. We warmly welcome you to join in and try out the game!

This is a thrilling and challenging motorcycle racing game. In this world, speed and power are the keys to victory. You can choose to outpace all your opponents with exceptional driving skills, or arm yourself with various weapons to eliminate enemies on the track. Here, we provide you with a platform to showcase your abilities and pursue victory.

If you encounter any issues during the trial, or if you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to join our official Discord community and share your experiences with us.

Official Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/v59S3SX3gZ]https://discord.gg/v59S3SX3gZ[/url]
